# Forecast and levers (generated by `_build/forecast.py`)

**Method.** Monthly revenue (SUM order_total) on the 19 full months Apr 2023 to Oct 2024. Rolling-origin backtest: train on the first 10 to 13 months, forecast the next 6, repeat. Best model by MAPE: **Naive (last full month)** (MAPE 2.8%, 24 forecasts; 6-month holdout May to Oct 2024 trained on Apr 2023 to Apr 2024: 2.9%). 80% band = ±5.0% (80th percentile of absolute backtest error).

| Model | Backtest MAPE |
|---|---|
| Naive (last full month) | 2.8% |
| Mean of last 3 months | 3.9% |
| Mean of all months | 4.2% |
| Mean of last 6 months | 4.6% |
| Linear trend | 4.8% |
| Seasonal naive (same month last year) | 7.1% |

**Forecast.** Nov 2024 to Dec 2025: flat at ₹5.38 L a month (band ₹5.11 L to ₹5.64 L). 2025 total ₹64.52 L (80% band ₹61.32 L to ₹67.72 L), -3.1% vs the last 12 full months (₹66.60 L). Seasonality cannot be estimated from 19 noisy points (seasonal naive is the worst model); Apr to Oct 2024 ran -4.5% vs 2023, so the flat forecast already sits below last year. The data is synthetic: treat the forecast as a baseline, not a prediction.

## Levers (basis: last 12 full months, Nov 2023 to Oct 2024; revenue ₹66.60 L)

| Lever | Type | Annual value | % of revenue | Assumption | Confidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cut late deliveries and low ratings by 5 points each | Exposure removed (combined) | ₹5.12 L | 7.68% | One scenario on late OR low-rated orders: late-only and low-only exposure scale by their cut, orders that are both leave only if both are fixed (independent fixes) | Low: delay and rating are not linked in this data |
| Cut late deliveries by 5 points | Exposure removed | ₹2.64 L | 3.97% | Late share 31.6% to 26.6%; late orders that are also rated 1-2 stars stay at risk | Low: delay does not move the rating in this data |
| Cut 1-2 star ratings by 5 points | Exposure removed | ₹2.31 L | 3.46% | Low-rating share 21.4% to 16.4%; low-rated orders that are also late stay at risk | Low: no cause identified in the data |
| Move 20% of App spend to Email | Attributed revenue gained | ₹67,456 | 1.01% | App ROAS 1.92x vs Email 2.05x; bootstrap 95% interval of the gap +0.05 to +0.21x | Low: small gap, and attributed revenue is not order revenue |
| Cut stock damage by 0.5 points | Stock value saved | ₹43,325 | 0.65% | Damage rate 1.71% to 1.21% of units received, valued at list price (upper bound: cost price is lower) | Medium: unit counts are real, value is at list price |

Lever values are not additive across types: exposure removed is revenue that stops being at risk, not new revenue; attributed revenue is the marketing file's own attribution; stock value is at list price.
